verdict.rationale: Jan's primary interface is natural-language chat, and its docs say you can 'give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research.' Natural-language requests drive MCP tool calls, which you approve inline, as well as browser automation through Jan Browser MCP and actions via messaging channels. Product management itself (model import, Hub search, settings) is documented as UI-driven rather than chat-driven, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: evidence that Jan's own configuration and model management can be driven by natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous task execution.
